notes.zh: 修复下载更新后安装程序未出现、旧版本目录无法覆盖的问题；加入启动回执、可查看日志、取消安装保护及安装后自动重开。安装占用减少约30.5%，保留自带运行时；更新双语指南与详细邮箱连接诊断。
notes.en: Fixes update installer handoff and upgrading legacy versioned folders. Adds installer acknowledgment, diagnostic logs, safe cancellation and verified relaunch. Reduces installed payload by 30.5% while remaining self-contained; includes bilingual guides and detailed mailbox diagnostics.

notes.zh: 全新四页侧栏：邮件报告、邮箱与检查、AI服务、通用设置。报告正文通高显示；切页保留未保存输入，首次配置后同步表单；新增脱敏邮箱连接诊断和双语使用指南。
notes.en: New four-page sidebar for reports, mailboxes, AI and general settings. Full-height Markdown reader, preserved form drafts and first-run form synchronization, detailed sanitized mailbox diagnostics and bilingual guides.
